commit.message: feat(ops): add fenced SADHANA deployment candidate

interface_mismatches: A deployment candidate cannot truthfully use canonical-release admission because it is not merged; the release manifest therefore carries an explicit unmerged class and false canonical_or_merged bit.

The dashboard normally targets the full writable API, but this campaign needs only the immutable mission projection; the dedicated observer reuses the admitted provider and endpoint logic without composing SwarmManager or runtime databases.
A copied virtual environment can still contain symlinks; --copies is necessary but insufficient, so the staged tree is recursively checked for links escaping its own venv root.
Replicated database bytes do not transfer writer authority; every snapshot manifest must state writer_authority_transferred=false and AGNI services stay fenced.
Systemd process state and Tailscale reachability prove availability only; useful work still requires owner execution evidence plus independent acceptance.

The runtime preparation implementation requires service-euid custody while its release and pin inputs must not be service-writable. Staging therefore derives one root-owned mode-0600 per-release EnvironmentFile solely from the validated sealed input set, exact-copies the Gitless admission into a separate service-owned mode-0600 projection, and automatically starts the static private-network preparation oneshot without enabling it; deploy fails unless root revalidates its paused NoEffect proof, and only a later root-binding transaction can promote that proof.

Pre/post Unix-socket pathname identity does not exclude an ABA rename-bind-restore substitution; the positive reader proof therefore requires Linux SO_PEERCRED on the exact connected socket to equal the admitted dashboard PID/uid/gid before sending the request.

The HMAC source must be inventoried without entering argv or environment and must be inaccessible in the dispatch namespace. The supervisor therefore receives only the fixed systemd LoadCredential mapping and reads the fixed CREDENTIALS_DIRECTORY file after runtime custody checks, while the live gate separately reproves bearer-copy equality. A disposable Ubuntu 24.04 systemd 255 run proved the source/runtime split, but live-host activation evidence remains mandatory.
honest_blockers: Local static and subprocess tests cannot prove remote systemd, Tailscale ACL, DNS, SSH host-key, provider quota, or iPhone reachability; live host canaries remain mandatory before checkout.

The release script never auto-promotes AGNI and intentionally offers no automatic failover subcommand; a human must establish Megh fencing and independently inspect a fresh snapshot before any later promotion packet.
The exact final integration SHA and external closeout receipt are necessarily sealed after this implementation lands; no fixture may substitute placeholder hashes.

The release lane binds the typed no-effect preparation receipt, authority-manifest v4, fixed supervisor manifest arguments, and HMAC credential boundary, but final integration must contain their matching mission-runtime and preparation implementations and this release must remain the sole direct child before the envelope can be sealed.

The mobile bridge is pinned to /v1/operator-control/requests and the two-reader probe binds the shared operator-control protocol; final promotion still requires a direct-child restack and rerun of those route/API tests with the exact integrated objects.

A disposable disabled Linux systemd run must still prove PR_SET_DUMPABLE hostile-child resistance and the exact PrivateNetwork/ProtectSystem oracle unit at the final SHA; macOS fixtures prove only source semantics.

The installed Linux /usr/bin/rrsync -wo -no-del and rsync version must still prove the exact ACK checksum dry-run contract against a disposable standby tree; source tests cannot promote that host-specific behavior.

The installer stages disabled code and never creates or discloses secret values; scoped mode-0600 environment and credential files, pinned SSH known-hosts, post-bootstrap runtime manifests, the oracle sandbox evidence receipt, and a fresh AGNI capacity receipt remain activation inputs.
No VPS, Tailscale route, external account, provider, publication surface, or remote Git ref was mutated by this implementation packet.
session_entry.rollback: Run the exact release rollback command to disable and stop dispatch first, then the predispatch target, emergency recovery path, and deadline timer; prove every campaign unit and listener quiet; reset only an unchanged release-owned Serve route; remove only the exact writer marker; publish an immutable restart-denial receipt; leave AGNI fenced; and retain the exact release directory and snapshots for forensics. Receipt replay revalidates all live quiet-state and retention claims. Reverting this commit removes only tracked deployment tooling; it does not silently delete remote state.
